launched one of the largest corporate junk bond offerings in history to help fund its major push into artificial intelligence.

One of the world's biggest investors in AI, SoftBank started marketing the multi-part deal, with price talk underway for the dollar portion, according to reports. The group aims to raise the equivalent of more than $11B in the offering that includes a $10B dollar part and a €1B ($1.1B) euro portion.
The offering is the latest in a flurry of activity by SoftBank in debt markets this year to help fund commitments nearing $65B to ChatGPT creator OpenAI, as well as more M&A in the sector.

SoftBank, however, isn't alone in storming markets for funding, with global AI-related debt issuance already topping $575B in 2026, according to a recent report by Goldman Sachs Group Inc. credit strategists.

title: SoftBank markets $11B high-yield bond offering to support AI growth
